_comment: How each machine reaches the lab share. The catalog stores paths relative
to it, so a library catalogued from a Mac and the same library catalogued
from Windows come out identical -- see app/share.py.
mounts is every prefix a person might paste, and which flavour of path to
show them back; for a flavour with several, the FIRST is the one shown.
CHECK THE mac PREFIX against how people actually mount the share -- a
prefix that is wrong here does not break anything quietly, it rejects
those users' paths as 'not on the share'.
The server works out its own way in from the same list: the first mount
for its kind of machine that exists there. So this one file serves the
Windows PCs and the Linux box alike. Set server_root only for a server
that reaches the share some way no person does.
require_on_share: false lets libraries outside the share be catalogued.
Leave it true -- an entry nobody else can open defeats the point.
